content:
No, there is not. I think the philosophy is that an email is like a legal document (and some are) and should never be altered. In practice, you could export a message in eml format, which is plain text which could then be edited with a text editor then re-import it. Not "easy."

I've often wished Thunderbird had the ability to add user notes to a message. There are add-ons like XNote++ that claim to do this.
